note: Read-only checks V1 to V12 of PLAN.md section 8. Identifiers and aggregates only.

V1.against: PLAN-v2 assumed 2.0 / 1.5 / 1.0 / 0.7 / 0.5: LEO is 1.4 to 4 times higher, GNSS 1.3 times.

V2.detail: Regime comes from each set's mean altitude (un-Kozai'd, WGS-72) and eccentricity, as CA does. Swarm A/B/C and GRACE-FO are LEO-L (Swarm B 480 km). CryoSat-2, SARAL, Sentinel-1A/C and Sentinel-3A/B are LEO-M (Sentinel-3 mean altitude is below 800 km). Jason-3, Sentinel-6A/B, HY-2C/D and SWOT are LEO-H. LAGEOS-2, Etalon-1/2 and the GNSS MEO satellites are MEO. BeiDou GEO/IGSO satellites and QZS-3 (and one more ESA GNSS satellite) fall in GEO by altitude (8 objects). One ESA GNSS set lands in HEO (5 rows): HEO has no usable dev truth.

ESA finals.basis: day 2026-10-30 (doy 303) present, doy 304 absent at the 2026-11-04T03:44Z run

Sentinel-1 POEORB.basis: creation time minus validity end over 1817 files (median 19.26; reprocessed files up to 224 d excluded from the figure); Sentinel-1A truth ends 2026-07

DORIS upper bounds per satellite.basis: newest arc end per satellite against the 2026-11-04T03:41Z fetch; the regime takes the maximum: LEO-M 29.2, LEO-H 32.2

V3.detail: PLAN-v2 assumed ESA 14 d, ilrsa 11 d, DORIS at least 17 d, S1 about 20 d. Measured: ESA is 3 to 4 d, ilrsa up to 17 d, DORIS 16 to 32 d by satellite, S1 19.3 d. Open dates use the used column (PLAN.md section 11).

V4.detail: Fixed families: Swarm A+C, Swarm B, GRACE-FO 1+2, Sentinel-1A+C, CryoSat-2, SARAL, Sentinel-3A+B, HY-2C, HY-2D, SWOT, Jason-3+Sentinel-6A+B, LAGEOS-2, Etalon-1+2. GNSS planes from the ascending node and inclination of one set per satellite (gap rule, 20 degrees). Cluster counts per stratum are in dev-rows-summary.json.

V5.detail: WAAS records in AR/hac/cddis-sbas are broadcast navigation messages (gpsMs, ECEF r and v, URA, health). P_truth is zero in every label row, so URA is a sensitivity row only. A WAAS-to-reference-state conversion is not built here: no module converts a geostationary broadcast message to GCRF states, and no physics is written in JavaScript. GEO dev truth is the ESA finals (BeiDou GEO/IGSO, QZS-3); WAAS dev rows are PENDING.

V6.detail: AR/hac/gfz-kp/20261009 Kp_ap_Ap_SN_F107_since_1932.txt ends with day 2026-10-08. Storm marking of dev rows to 2026-09-22 is covered; fresh days need O5.

V7.detail: TDRSS.bsp comment area is an SPKMERGE log of ten TDRS source kernels (-124 to -221) ending 2026-02-09/11. It does not state definitive or predicted. TDRS has no dev rows.

V8.detail: Dev rows: 2.3 million rows (68 thousand sets, 114 objects) in about 2 minutes on 8 workers; set extraction 25 monthly workers in about 3 minutes.

V9.detail: C2 PLAN.md dates table: calibration 2025-10-03 to 2026-03-31, validation 2026-04-01 to 2026-05-31, held out by time 2026-06-01 to the end of each product, scored once. C2's own score date for the S1C and COSMIC-2 days is not stated in that table; the O3 default (open them only after C2 scores) therefore has no computable open date and S1C/COSMIC-2 fresh strata read PENDING on that interlock.

V10.detail: Debris error against payload error: a stated limit.

V11.detail: object_covariance population fallback: linear in age between usable bin centers (center = midpoint of the bin), held beyond the first and last (gp-error-model README and covariance_realism.cpp). empiricalPc (conjunction-assessment bridge, blob in pins.json): regime from the set's mean altitude (un-Kozai'd, WGS-72) and eccentricity, the age bin containing TCA minus epoch (the last bin closed at 8 d), the stratum's covariance used unchanged (a step in age, no interpolation); a stratum without 21 values or without a usable position block is skipped.

V12.detail: AR/hac/.fetch-stamps holds per-host stamps (cddis.nasa.gov, isdc-data.gfz.de, ssd.jpl.nasa.gov and others, the newest 2026-11-03 for CDDIS). The DORIS, S1 POEORB, ESA and ILRS files were retrieved 2026-10-09 by hac-data-sources-inventory-20261009 (provenance files). No rerunnable collector for them was found in this lane's reach; nothing was fetched.

conversions.DORIS: CryoSat-2, SARAL, Sentinel-3A/B, SWOT by the module reference-states script; HY-2C, HY-2D, Jason-3, Sentinel-6A and Sentinel-6B added to its satellite map (their arcs have no overlapping neighbor, so the module's stated sigma is a placeholder 0.1 m, flagged in the product basis and never read: P_truth is zero). Output outside the repository, EOP from the archived C04 file. The script reads only local archive copies.
